name: Outline
description: Turn text into a structured blog or article outline
promptTemplate:
Turn the following text into a clear blog or article outline. Use a hierarchical structure with a title, section headings (##), and 2-3 bullet sub-points under each. Keep it faithful to the source material:

"{{input}}"

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the outline. Do NOT include any introductory notes or explanations.
